R7AE-bear-backcountry-0003.name: By Cut Thumb Creek
R7AE-bear-backcountry-0003.pressureWhy: More than 5 km from a drivable road (estimate).

evidence.t: Cutblock harvested 2021 (5 years old), right here: cutblocks and logging road edges green up first in spring (65%) and grow berries for the fall feed (lesson: Black bear).
SE facing slope, 17 degrees: grassy south facing slopes are spring bear food (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
Cut Thumb Creek 90 m SE: stream sides and skunk cabbage swamps are spring food, and bears forage on berries and spawning fish in fall (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
1 km or more from pavement and 2 km from a town: bears near people feed more at night (75%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 6).

plan: Drive: from District of Mackenzie, about 39 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 55.57556, -123.14976, pull off on Ty 13100 (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk: 5.1 km NW, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 589 m, about 161 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 200 m E of the spot at 915 m (55.60698, -123.20516). Water: Cut Thumb Creek right here (estimate).

Hunt: black bear, Apr, May, June, Aug, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Glass berry slopes, cutblocks and road edges at dawn and the last 2 hours of light, wind in your face (Tip). A bear under 2 years old and any bear with it are closed (99%, synopsis page 11).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 180 grain expanding bullet (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-30, Region 7A. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-04, closures 2026-10-16.
R7AE-bear-backcountry-0003.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 7-30: about 512 hunter days a year for black bear (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.21 days per square km, middle third of BC MUs; access: more than 5 km from a drivable road. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

R7AE-grouse-atv-0002.name: By Cut Thumb Creek
R7AE-grouse-atv-0002.pressureWhy: No town, pavement or rec site within 1 km and not behind a closure (estimate).
R7AE-grouse-atv-0002.parkWhat: where the truck road ends (Ty 13100); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle)

evidence.t: Road: Cut Thumb Main, 5.6 km stretch.
100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
3 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
9 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.
Black bear: young cutblocks and burns grow berries in late summer and fall (Tip).

seasonRows.notes: No row in the Region 7A table (page 57), so no general open season (page 5: open seasons are only those in the synopsis). MU 7-1 is listed in Region 7A on page 2 but no row names it.

plan: Drive: from District of Mackenzie, about 39 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 55.57556, -123.14976, where the truck road ends (Ty 13100); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle). Map links below.
Walk 5.1 km to the start. Ride: the Cut Thumb Main stretch, 5.6 km one way. About 112 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-30, Region 7A. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-04, closures 2026-10-16.
